2610.08760.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds
2610.08760.paper_summary: Recent advances in world models have enabled increasingly realistic visual synthesis. However, these generated environments remain largely silent. Bringing sound to world models poses three core challenges: real-time generation to keep pace with interactive video streams, interactive control to respond to mid-stream sound instructions, and spatially aligned stereo to reflect scene geometry and camera motion. To address these demands, we introduce WorldSonus, an interactive video-to-audio framework designed for real-time spatial sound synthesis in world models. For real-time generation, WorldSonus employs a streaming causal autoregressive diffusion architecture that synthesizes audio chunks at a low real-time factor (RTF) of 0.41. For interactive control, we incorporate an audio-centric captioning pipeline with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling, enabling dynamic manipulation of sound events during generation. For spatial alignment, we leverage high-quality stereo supervision curated from diverse stereo and ambisonic data. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while tailored for world models, WorldSonus generalizes effectively to open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks, matching or outperforming state-of-the-art bidirectional models in both acoustic quality and spatial alignment. Project page: https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
2610.08760.paper_summary_zh: 最近在世界模型方面的進展使得越來越現實的視覺合成成為可能。<lb/>然而，這些生成的環境仍然在很大程度上保持沉默。<lb/>為世界模型帶來聲音面臨三個核心挑戰：實時生成以跟上互動視頻流、互動控制以響應中途的聲音指令，以及空間對齊立體聲以反映場景幾何和相機運動。<lb/>為了解決這些需求，我們介紹了WorldSonus，一個旨在實時空間聲音合成的互動視頻到音頻框架。<lb/>在實時生成方面，WorldSonus採用了流式因果自回歸擴散架構，以低實時因子（RTF）0.41合成音頻片段。<lb/>在互動控制方面，我們整合了一個以音頻為中心的標題生成管道，並使用基於片段索引的提示調度，實現了在生成過程中動態操控聲音事件。<lb/>在空間對齊方面，我們利用從多樣的立體和環繞聲數據中策劃的高質量立體監督。<lb/>大量實驗表明，儘管WorldSonus是為世界模型量身定制的，但它在開放域的視頻到音頻基準中有效地進行了泛化，在聲學質量和空間對齊方面與最先進的雙向模型相匹配或超越。<lb/>項目頁面：https://noizai.github.io/WorldSonus/
